backing.attachment_point_vintage_note: INDICATIVE, NOT MEASURED: a JUNE 2026 junior figure over a 2026-08-23 on-chain senior read. Numerator and denominator are ~2 months apart. ⚠️ This does NOT weaken the finding — the denominator is the operand that GREW, so the true current figure is more likely BELOW 9.66% than above it.
backing.backing_score_basis: ⚠️ AUTHORED, NOT COMPUTED — a FALLBACK that yields to any derived collateral ratio. Used because PegTracker DECLARES no ratio is establishable for this asset: Re's reserve dashboard combines reUSD and reUSDe and exposes no asset-attributed denominator. Collateral quality is genuinely good (USDC, USDe, sUSDe, T-Bills behind a reinsurance book); held to 5.5 by the 9.66% attachment point sitting BELOW the 10% institutional norm, and by the NAV being admin-written on SharePriceCalculator so the reserve's own mark is issuer-controlled.
backing.backing_score_applies_when_note: ⚠️ MUST NOT fire on a merely-absent collateral_ratio. The producer declares this one underivable in collateral_ratio_basis. A bare null can also mean a failed fetch or a feed outage — and promoting an authored score over a measurement that exists but did not load is the failure where a failed read lands wherever the substitute sits. Require the DECLARATION, not the absence.
